title: SM+ (Sinar Mas)
bottom_line: Franky Oesman Widjaja controls DSSA (59.9% through PT Sinar Mas Tunggal), which owns SM+ outright, but SM+'s flagship SMX01 is a joint venture in which Korea's KIRA holds about half; LG Sinar Mas (the LG CNS joint venture) designs it, installs its Rp1.23 tn of electrical, cooling and IT systems and will run it, Acset puts up the Rp803 bn building, and the money comes from about Rp1.1 tn of DSSA bonds and sukuk plus a Rp2.97 tn Mandiri loan. No Sinar Mas power plant feeds it: DSSA sold its captive plants to the APP paper mills in 2024 and 75% of its three coal IPPs (which sell to PLN outside Java) to China's Datang in 2020, so SMX01's power deal is with PLN's Jakarta unit. The edge network is about 10 MW of former Smartfren buildings, not the 43 MW analysts cite, and Sinar Mas's bigger data-centre role is as landlord: its Kota Deltamas estate sold GIIC land to Microsoft, AWS, PDG, STT GDC and others, and data-centre buyers made up 94% of the estate company's land sales in H1 2026.

entities.name: SM+ Data Centers
entities.what: Sinar Mas's data-centre and digital-infrastructure platform under DSSA ('SM+ Holdings'). It runs 25 edge data centres in 24 cities (about 10 MW) and is building the SMX01 metro data centre in Jakarta's CBD. In Oct 2026 it agreed to buy PDG's five Indonesian enterprise data centres, which would take it to 31 sites in 25 cities.

entities.name: DSSA (Dian Swastatika Sentosa)
entities.what: IDX-listed Sinar Mas holding (IDX: DSSA) for coal (GEMS), renewables, digital infrastructure (SM+, MoraRepublic) and chemicals; 59.90% owned by PT Sinar Mas Tunggal. It sold its captive power plants to the Indah Kiat and Pindo Deli paper mills on 30 Apr 2024.

entities.name: Sinar Mas Tunggal
entities.what: DSSA's main shareholder (59.90% at 31 Dec 2025), controlled by Franky Oesman Widjaja according to DSSA's annual report.

entities.name: DSST Mas Gemilang
entities.what: DSSA's 99.999% holding company for its technology businesses. It sits above SM+ (PT SMPlus Digital Investama), MyRepublic's owner PT Innovate Mas Utama and PT Bali Media Telekomunikasi.

entities.name: SMPlus Sentra Data (SMSD)
entities.what: Holding company 99.999% owned by SM+. It owns half of KMG (the SMX01 company) plus SMSDP and SMSS, and passes DSSA bond money on to KMG.

entities.name: SMPlus Sentra Data Persada (SMSDP)
entities.what: SM+'s edge data-centre company, founded 27 Nov 2023 for 'hosting activities'. In Dec 2023 it agreed to buy Smartfren's and Smart Telecom's data-centre property in 21 cities for Rp544.2 bn; commercial operation started in 2024.

entities.name: Kuningan Mas Gemilang (KMG)
entities.what: SMX01's project company, set up on 30 Apr 2024. DSSA's effective stake fell from 99.999% (2024) to 50.000% (2025); SM+ and LG name KIRA as its joint-venture partner. KMG holds the SMX01 land, the LG Sinar Mas and Acset contracts and a Rp2.97 tn Mandiri loan.

entities.name: SMPlus Solusi Sejahtera (SMSS)
entities.legal_name: PT SMPlus Solusi Sejahtera (formerly PT Teknovatus Solusi Sejahtera)
entities.what: Technology-services company, operating since 2014, bought by SM+ on 7 Aug 2024 from PT Bakti Taruna Sejati and renamed; financed by BSI.

entities.name: LG Sinar Mas (LGSM)
entities.what: IT-services and data-centre joint venture of LG CNS and SM+ (agreement 27 Mar 2024, company set up 25 Jul 2024, launched 10 Sep 2024). It is SMX01's design, build and operating partner; SM+ holds 49.999%.

entities.name: LG CNS
entities.what: Korean IT-services company of the LG group and co-owner of LG Sinar Mas. Through the JV it leads the roughly KRW 100 bn cooling, power and telecom package for SMX01. LG Sinar Mas calls it the largest data-centre operator in Korea.

entities.name: KIRA (Korea Investment Real Asset Management)
entities.legal_name: Korea Investment Real Asset Management Co., Ltd. (investing via KIRA SG One Pte. Ltd.)
entities.what: Korean alternative-asset manager, a direct subsidiary of Korea Investment Holdings, with over US$5 bn under management (Dec 2024). It is SM+'s joint-venture partner in KMG/SMX01 and lent KMG and SMSD a US$15.5 mn convertible loan through KIRA SG One Pte. Ltd.

entities.name: Bumi Serpong Damai (BSDE)
entities.what: Listed property developer and a Sinar Mas affiliate (DSSA files deals with it as affiliated transactions). It sold KMG the SMX01 plot in Menteng Atas, South Jakarta (deed 28 May 2025), which DSSA disclosed as an affiliated transaction.

entities.name: SMX01 (Jakarta CBD)
entities.what: SM+'s flagship metro data centre in Menteng Atas, Setiabudi, South Jakarta: US$300 mn+, 18 MW IT at start (DSSA: 18.0 MW+) scalable to 60 MW, about 15,500 m2 of white space for about 2,400 racks of up to 130 kW, Tier IV design. Under construction: topped off May 2026, ready for service targeted Q4 2026.

entities.name: Princeton Digital Group (PDG)
entities.what: Singapore-based data-centre operator. It is selling its five-site Indonesian enterprise business to SM+ while keeping its ~400 MW hyperscale campuses (JC2, JC3, JC4); in H1 2026 it paid DMAS Rp446.1 bn, matching its JC4 'powered land' purchase in GIIC.

entities.name: PDG Indonesia enterprise data centres (ID1)
entities.what: PDG's 'ID1' portfolio: five operational data centres in Cibitung, Bintaro, Bandung, Pekanbaru and Surabaya, 11 MW in total, PUE 1.74; PDG bought them from XL Axiata in 2019. SM+ signed to buy the business on 12 Oct 2026; closing is pending and no price is published.

entities.name: PDG Cibitung enterprise site
entities.what: Operational enterprise data centre in PDG's ID1 portfolio (11 MW across five sites; no per-site MW). PDG lists it as 'Jakarta Cibitung', the same location as the 22 MW JC2 hyperscale building that PDG keeps. Due to pass to SM+ when the Oct 2026 deal closes (inferred).

entities.name: PDG Bintaro (JB1)
entities.what: Operational enterprise data centre in PDG's ID1 portfolio (11 MW across five sites; no per-site MW). PDG calls it JB1 Bintaro; it got new HVAC and piloted HVO fuel for its generators. Due to pass to SM+ when the Oct 2026 deal closes (inferred).

entities.name: PDG Bandung (BD1)
entities.what: Operational enterprise data centre in PDG's ID1 portfolio (11 MW across five sites; no per-site MW). PDG calls it BD1 Bandung; it got new HVAC systems. Due to pass to SM+ when the Oct 2026 deal closes (inferred).

entities.name: PDG Surabaya (SB1)
entities.what: Operational enterprise data centre in PDG's ID1 portfolio (11 MW across five sites; no per-site MW). PDG calls it SB1 Surabaya; it got new HVAC systems. Due to pass to SM+ when the Oct 2026 deal closes (inferred).

entities.name: PDG Pekanbaru
entities.what: Operational enterprise data centre in PDG's ID1 portfolio (11 MW across five sites; no per-site MW). PDG lists it as 'Pekanbaru'. Due to pass to SM+ when the Oct 2026 deal closes (inferred).

entities.name: UBS AG Singapore Branch
entities.what: Exclusive financial adviser to SM+ on the PDG acquisition (Oct 2026).

entities.name: Acset
entities.what: Listed Indonesian contractor; SMX01's building contractor. KMG was 32.74% of Acset's revenue in H1 2026 (Rp292.0 bn).

entities.name: LG Electronics
entities.what: Supplies the data-centre cooling for SMX01's hybrid air- and liquid-cooled design in LG CNS's 'One LG' package.

entities.name: LG Energy Solution
entities.what: Supplies battery solutions for SMX01 in the same 'One LG' package (UPS or storage not stated).

entities.name: Konst
entities.what: Taiwanese AI-infrastructure firm founded in 2024 (about 42 MW in operation and development in nine countries). In Aug 2026 it signed for liquid-cooled, high-density capacity at SMX01 for GPU cloud, its first deployment outside Taiwan.

entities.name: Giga Computing
entities.what: GIGABYTE subsidiary supplying the GPU servers for Konst's deployment at SMX01 (tenant equipment, not the building's).

entities.name: PLN
entities.what: State power utility. Its Jakarta Raya distribution unit (UID Jakarta Raya) signed SMX01's supply agreement with KMG in Nov 2024; it supplies GIIC's data-centre zone (993 MVA) and buys the output of the IPPs in which DSSA keeps 25%.

entities.name: Cikarang Listrindo
entities.what: Listed private power producer (IDX: POWR) serving the Cikarang industrial estates. It supplies PDG's Cibitung campus, including biomass power for up to 20% of the campus since Aug 2023.

entities.name: Datang DSSP Power Indonesia (DDPI)
entities.what: Holds Sinar Mas's three coal IPPs (Sumsel-5 300 MW, Kalselteng-1 200 MW, Kendari-3 100 MW: 600 MW). DSSA sold 75% to Datang Overseas in Dec 2020 and keeps 25% through PT Energi Mas Anugerah Semesta.

entities.name: Datang Overseas (Hong Kong)
entities.legal_name: Datang Overseas (Hong Kong) Energy Investment Co., Limited
entities.what: Overseas investment arm of China's Datang power group; bought 75% of DDPI from DSSA in Dec 2020 (US$394 mn according to Global Energy Monitor).

entities.name: DSSP Power Sumsel (PLTU Sumsel-5)
entities.what: 2 x 150 MW coal IPP in Musi Banyuasin, South Sumatra, commercial since 2016; sells to PLN under a 25-year build-own-operate-transfer PPA. It paid DSSA's group US$43.2 mn in 2025.

entities.name: DSSP Power Kendari (PLTU Kendari-3)
entities.what: 2 x 50 MW coal IPP in Southeast Sulawesi, commercial since 2019; paid DSSA's group US$27.1 mn in 2025.

entities.name: SKS Listrik Kalimantan (PLTU Kalselteng-1)
entities.what: 2 x 100 MW coal IPP in Gunung Mas, Central Kalimantan (built by Dongfang Electric, commissioned 2020); paid DSSA's group US$30.7 mn in 2025.

entities.name: Golden Energy Mines (GEMS)
entities.what: DSSA's 51%-owned coal miner and trader (Borneo Indobara, Kuansing Inti Makmur and others). DSSA says energy cash flow lets it invest in renewables and digital infrastructure.

entities.name: Daya Mas Bumi Sentosa (DMBS)
entities.what: Geothermal JV of DSSA (through PT DSSR Daya Mas Sakti) and PT FirstGen Geothermal Indonesia: six working areas with about 440 MW of potential in West Java, East Nusa Tenggara, Jambi, West Sumatra and Central Sulawesi, still at exploration and development stage. No data-centre supply found.

entities.name: FirstGen Geothermal Indonesia
entities.what: Indonesian unit of the Philippines' Energy Development Corporation (First Gen group); DSSA's geothermal JV partner.

entities.name: Trina Mas Agra Indonesia (TMAI)
entities.what: Solar cell and module factory in Kendal Industrial Park (about 1 GW a year, opened Jun 2025), a JV of DSSA, Trina Solar Energy Development Pte. Ltd. and PT PLN Indonesia Power Renewables. A supplier of panels, not of power to data centres.

entities.name: Dian Solar
entities.legal_name: PT Daya Mas Agra Sejahtera (brand owner)
entities.what: DSSA's solar brand (panels and rooftop systems), launched 2024; rooftop contracts include 1.6 MWp in Marunda and Sentul and 0.8 MWp in Riau. No data-centre installation found.

entities.name: Bank Mandiri
entities.what: State bank; lent KMG up to Rp2.97 tn over seven years for SMX01 (15 Jan 2026). It also lends to MyRepublic (EMR).

entities.name: BCA
entities.what: Lent SMSDP up to Rp400 bn (3 Nov 2025) for data-centre development, with a DSSA corporate guarantee; nothing drawn at end-2025.

entities.name: Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI)
entities.what: Islamic bank; financed SMSS with a Rp5.2 bn musyarakah facility and a Rp15.4 bn line facility (Jan 2024; the line was repaid in Nov 2025).

entities.name: Aldiracita Sekuritas
entities.what: Joint lead underwriter of DSSA's Rp7 tn shelf bond and sukuk programme (first tranche Mar 2024); later tranches funded SMX01 and the edge network.

entities.name: BCA Sekuritas
entities.what: Joint lead underwriter of DSSA's Rp7 tn shelf bond and sukuk programme (first tranche Mar 2024); later tranches funded SMX01 and the edge network.

entities.name: BNI Sekuritas
entities.what: Joint lead underwriter of DSSA's Rp7 tn shelf bond and sukuk programme (first tranche Mar 2024); later tranches funded SMX01 and the edge network.

entities.name: Mandiri Sekuritas
entities.what: Joint lead underwriter of DSSA's Rp7 tn shelf bond and sukuk programme (first tranche Mar 2024); later tranches funded SMX01 and the edge network.

entities.name: Trimegah Sekuritas
entities.what: Joint lead underwriter of DSSA's Rp7 tn shelf bond and sukuk programme (first tranche Mar 2024); later tranches funded SMX01 and the edge network.

entities.name: XLSMART
entities.legal_name: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk (IDX: EXCL)
entities.what: Mobile operator that DSSA's report calls 'formerly known as PT Smartfren Telecom Tbk'. Smartfren and its unit Smart Telecom sold SM+ its first edge data centres (21 cities, Dec 2023); DSSA now owns 24.57% of XLSMART through BMT, and XLSMART signed an MoU with SM+ in Aug 2026.

entities.name: Bali Media Telekomunikasi (BMT)
entities.what: DSSA holding company (99.99% through DSST) that owns 24.57% of XLSMART; DSST added Rp8.54 tn of capital on 6 Jul 2026.

entities.name: MoraRepublic
entities.legal_name: PT Ekamas Mora Republik Tbk (IDX: MORA)
entities.what: Fibre and FTTH operator formed on 22 Apr 2026 by merging Moratelindo with DSSA's MyRepublic (PT Eka Mas Republik); DSSA's effective stake is 50.5%, held via PT Innovate Mas Utama. It runs six data centres (3.3 MW) and signed an MoU with SM+ in Aug 2026.

entities.name: Moratelindo data centres (6 sites)
entities.what: Six data centres with 3.3 MW (Sep 2025) that MoraRepublic took over from Moratelindo; no site-level figures (the map's moratelindo-dcs record lists Jakarta, Batam, Medan, Palembang, Surabaya and Denpasar). Operating.

entities.name: Telin
entities.what: Carrier that hosted BATIC 2026, where it signed an MoU with SM+ Data Centers; also on SM+'s partner list.

entities.name: APJII
entities.what: Indonesian internet service providers' association; its MoU with SM+ brings the Indonesia Internet Exchange (IIX) into SMX01.

entities.name: Telkom Indonesia
entities.what: State telco. Its NeutraDC campus is a tenant of GIIC's data-centre zone, and its logo is on SM+'s partner list.

entities.name: Indosat
entities.what: Mobile operator; logo on SM+'s partner list (Oct 2026).

entities.name: PLN Icon Plus
entities.what: PLN group telecom company (logo 'PLN Icon Plus'); logo on SM+'s partner list (Oct 2026).

entities.name: China Mobile International
entities.what: International carrier; logo on SM+'s partner list (Oct 2026).

entities.name: Zenlayer
entities.what: Edge cloud and network provider; logo on SM+'s partner list (Oct 2026).

entities.name: Sinarmas Land
entities.what: Sinar Mas group property company. It owns 100% of PT Sumber Arusmulia, DMAS's 57.28% shareholder, and formed a hyperscale data-centre JV with K2 Data Centres in 2022. CEO: Muktar Widjaja.

entities.name: Sumber Arusmulia
entities.what: Holding company 100% owned by Sinarmas Land Ltd; owns 57.28% of DMAS.

entities.name: Puradelta Lestari (DMAS)
entities.what: IDX-listed developer of Kota Deltamas and the GIIC industrial estate in Cikarang. Ultimate controller: Margaretha Natalia Widjaja; shareholders PT Sumber Arusmulia 57.28%, Sojitz 25.00%, public 17.72%. Data-centre buyers made up 93.6% of its H1 2026 sales (Digital Gayana Ekagrata, PDG, Indoedge, STT GDC).

entities.name: Sojitz

entities.what: Microsoft's Indonesian data-centre company; bought Rp810.4 bn of GIIC land from DMAS in 2024 (40.9% of DMAS's sales) for its GIIC campus (JKT 11).

entities.name: AWS (Amazon Data Services Indonesia)
